picks.title: CorridorKey 2.0 just works...
picks.excerpt: Corridor Crew shows off CorridorKey 2.0, the new version of the in-house keying tool behind their AI VFX workflow, which composites actors into scenes without a traditional green-screen pull. The video description is only 'This Weekend.', so the enrichment pass needs to confirm what is new in 2.0.
picks.rationale: A new tool version (2.0) of an AI keying tool that skips the traditional green-screen pull. This is the most actionable item for VFX and compositing artists today; enrichment must confirm what 2.0 changes.

picks.title: Comics Accuse Hot AI Fakes of Stealing Their Jokes Word for Word to Push OnlyFans Pages
picks.excerpt: Stand-up comics are calling out accounts where AI-generated 'comics' plagiarize their jokes word for word, sometimes for millions of views, to push OnlyFans pages: 'AI stole my joke and my outfit.' Deadline also covered it, at https://deadline.com/2026/10/comedians-ai-joke-theft-natalie-cuomo-olivia-carter-1237165762/.
picks.rationale: A new incident: AI avatars lift stand-up material word for word and drive it to millions of views. Performers' written work is being copied, not just their likeness, which is a new angle on the creator-rights fight.

picks.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film 'the right way' and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
picks.excerpt: Actor and investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with AI in filmmaking if it's used 'to enhance what you're doing', and says he is open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy.
picks.rationale: An A-list actor, who is also an investor, openly endorses a posthumous AI clone. That runs against the talent pushback this section has been tracking (Cage, Cruise) and matters for likeness-licensing deals.

picks.title: 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' Composer and More Speak Out About AI at Ghent's WSA Film Music Days: 'We Must Continue to Defend Our Art'
picks.excerpt: At the World Soundtrack Awards, 'Avatar: Fire and Ash' composer Simon Franglen said the work of film composers and musicians can never be replicated by AI.
picks.rationale: Film-score composers had not appeared in this section before. A major event (the World Soundtrack Awards, Ghent) adds the music department's stance on AI.

picks.title: Tilly Nollywood? African Filmmakers — Ready or Not — Get Set for the AI Revolution
picks.excerpt: Generative AI could transform filmmaking in Africa, but practical challenges across the continent abound.
picks.rationale: A regional angle the section has not covered: how generative AI is reaching African production, including Nollywood, and the practical limits there (infrastructure, cost).

alternates.title: Alex Gibney on How a CGI Avatar Helped Simulate the Elon Musk Interview He Could Never Get
alternates.excerpt: Alex Gibney explains using artificial intelligence to critique it in his documentary 'Musk', building a CGI avatar to simulate the Elon Musk interview he could never get.
alternates.rationale: Held back: an interview about the AI use in 'Musk', which already ran on 09-28 via the Zurich Summit panel with the film's producer. It is commentary with no new release.
